class.desc: CSS classes set on the root element of the control (Quasar grid classes such as `col-md-6` work inside a layout with `row`).

readonly.desc: Render the control read-only (`readOnly` is accepted too). Also `readOnly` in the schema, or the `readonly` prop of `QJsonForm`.

format.desc: Select a renderer when the schema `format` is not set (`radio`, `checkbox`, `slider`, `range`, `rating`, `typeahead`, `markdown`, `datepicker`...).

validationMessage.desc: Message of the renderer-level checks, translated with `t()`: a string applies to every check of the control; in a map, `default` is the fallback of the named messages (`validationMessage.wordLimitError`...).

languages.desc: Languages of a localized string control, `['en', 'fr']` or `{ en: 'English' }`; defaults to `config.languages`, then the `languages` prop of `QJsonForm`.
